goal: Persist the curated Edgebox inventory and capability/provider relationships in SQLite with typed read/query behavior.
authority: User invoked run-wave for the two ready descendants of accepted add-edgebox-home-base architecture.

do_not: Edit package.json, bun.lock, application routes, UI components, or Pi infrastructure
Drop the existing task or auth tables
Implement health probing, Docker discovery, or operator administration

criteria: Drizzle migrations create and seed the curated inventory idempotently
Shared serializable catalog DTOs live under src/lib/catalog and match the accepted architecture
Repository/query tests cover visibility, filters, provider resolution, preference ownership, and invalid associations
All schema changes use generated committed migrations
